evals.prompt: I'm starting a new project in this folder: "repslog", a Spring Boot + Kotlin REST API that tracks my gym and running sessions, just for me for now. Nothing is built yet. Write its README.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: an empty git repo. A README with name, one-sentence description and status only.
expectations: It lists no install or run commands and no versions, because nothing is built
It has no filler sections: badges, table of contents, Contributing, feature list or planned endpoints

evals.prompt: The README is almost empty. Write a proper one.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: a monorepo with Java services, a TypeScript frontend, Terraform and Kubernetes files, and a very short README. A README whose every command and path exists, with an architecture diagram.
expectations: The architecture section has a Mermaid diagram of the components
The architecture diagram shows only connections the repo defines: no links invented between the frontend and the services
